scope: Aggregate local Git metadata. Not a valuation, ownership decision, security scan or buyer acceptance.

history.note: Counts and dates cover locally available reachable commits; a shallow repository omits earlier history. Commit timestamps may be rewritten and do not verify age, authorship or production use.

current_committed_tree.note: Committed HEAD only; file types are extension-based. Working-tree changes and source contents are not examined. Filename signals are not a secret scan.

not_assessed: secrets or personal data in contents/history
buyer fit, price or payment timing
sharing: Nothing is uploaded. Review this aggregate report and decide whether to share it yourself.
